BEIDOU M5 is classified as:

  • Beidou Navigation System


NORAD ID: 38774
Int'l Code: 2012-050A
Launch date: September 18, 2012
Source: People's Republic of China (PRC)
Launch site: Xichang Space Center, China (XSC)

The Beidou constellation, also known as Compass, is China's counterpart to the U.S. Air Force's Global Positioning System, which provides navigation services to military vehicles, precision munitions, civil aviation, personal cars, boats, and search-and-rescue forces. BEIDOU M5 is the 14th Beidou spacecraft in the program.
